app-templates.message:
refactor: one frame for every page of the three archetypes

## Intent

The quiz, the explainer and the interactive archetype each had their own CSS for the same page frame. The copies had drifted apart: interactive had no dark mode. The frame should exist once.

## Key changes

- runtime/shared/page.css holds the palette (one set of --page-* colours, light and dark), the reset, [hidden], the body, links, the focus ring, the header with the language switch and the footer. The archetypes' stylesheets keep only their own page.
- The --quiz-*, --explainer-* and --interactive-* palettes and their mapping to --question-* are gone; the questions use the page's colours.
- Header and footer are rendered once, with the classes page-header, page-languages and page-footer.
- The interactive archetype follows the dark scheme; its template's component uses the page's colours. --page-max-width replaces --interactive-max-width.
- The quiz page is a little wider (44 rem), has the line height of the others and no rule above its footer.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Apps built on the interactive template with fixed light colours in their components must switch to the --page-* colours.
